content: The EMPEROR-Preserved trial investigated the effects of empagliflozin in individuals diagnosed with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). The study demonstrated that empagliflozin significantly reduced the risk of hospitalization due to heart failure in this patient population. Additionally, the use of empagliflozin was associated with notable improvements in patients' overall health status, including better functional capacity and a reduction in the burden of symptoms related to heart failure. These findings underscore the therapeutic value of empagliflozin as an effective treatment option for patients with HFpEF, contributing to enhanced quality of life and a decreased likelihood of hospital admissions.
